brand.name: Sihha AI (صحة الذكاء الاصطناعي)
brand.tagline: The Premier Arabic-First AI Healthcare Ecosystem for Saudi Arabia
brand.market: Saudi Arabia (KSA) - Patients, Doctors, Clinics, Enterprise Hospitals
brand.archetype: Organic & Earthy with Saudi Clinical Authority
brand.emotional_tone: Authoritative, serene, deeply trusted, state-of-the-art Arabic medical intelligence

rules.text_contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Primary text on light background MUST be ink_dark (#1A201C). Never use grey on grey.
rules.hover_contrast: Always explicitly define hover text colors. Button primary: bg-forest_primary text-white hover:bg-forest_hover hover:text-white.
rules.gradient_limit: Strictly limited gradients under 15%. Rely on solid warm surfaces with refined borders.

typography.font_family_heading: IBM Plex Sans Arabic, Tajawal, Outfit, serif/sans-serif
typography.font_family_body: IBM Plex Sans Arabic, Inter, sans-serif

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-forest_primary leading-tight
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-ink_dark

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard (p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24)
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: Internal padding p-6 or p-8 for bordered cards to eliminate text collision
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Rounded-xl for cards (12px), rounded-full for pills, rounded-md for admin form elements
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: 3-column responsive layout for features, asymmetrical 12-column grid for hero and showcase

staging_environment.banner: Top persistent bar with slate-900 background, warning badge 'STAGING TEST ENVIRONMENT (NOT PRODUCTION)', account switcher quick action, and feature flag test trigger.

hero.headline: Saudi Arabia’s Arabic-First AI Healthcare Operating System
hero.subheadline: Empowering patients with 24/7 AI triage & pill ID, supporting clinicians with live Arabic AI scribe & SOAP notes, and unifying hospital networks.

sections: Hero Section with Arabic/English dual pill toggle & Trust Badges (MOH, SFDA, PDPL Compliant)
Key Audience Tabs: Patients (Pill ID & AI Chat), Doctors (Live Arabic Scribe & Visit Notes), Hospitals (White-Label & Workflow)
Live AI Scribe Interactive Proof Screen (Arabic Audio waveform + instant structured SOAP note generation)
White-Label Plug & Play Showcase for Hospitals (Brand color picker live preview, custom domain setup, logo uploader)
Pharmacy Marketplace & Pill Identification Scanner Demo Card
Investor & Enterprise Traction Metrics (99.4% Arabic Medical Dialect Accuracy, <30s Triage, 4.9/5 Clinical Satisfaction)
Regulatory & Compliance Guarantee (Saudi Data & AI Authority SDAIA, SFDA Class II AI, PDPL Law 2024)
Footer with Quick Nav, Staging Link, Language Selector, and Enterprise Contact Form

key_elements: Left Sidebar with Account Switcher dropdown: Shows current account name + MONOSPACE ID chip (e.g., 'ACC-98421') + 'RECENT ACCOUNTS' search filter
Quick Nav Search Input: Header search bar for super admins to instantly search any account by name, ID, domain, or email
Accounts List Screen: Header with 'Filter' toggle button, Name / Account Type dropdown filters, 'Showing 25 of 4,705 Accounts' counter badge

Account Table Rows: Account name, Status badge ('Subscribed' green, 'Trial' amber, 'Suspended' red), Type badge ('Self-serve' / 'Enterprise White-label'), 'X Locations X Users' meta, Monospace ID box with 1-click copy, Edit action, 'Switch to account >' link
Users Management Screen: 'Search by name or email' input, Table with Name, Email, Locations, Role dropdown selector, 'Invite User' modal

Account Detail Workspace (8 Tabs): Overview (Customer & Staff metrics), Users, Customers, White-Label Branding (Logo upload, Brand color swatches, Live preview card), Feature Flags (Account-specific overrides), Domain & Language (Arabic/English default, custom CNAME), Import Data (CSV uploader), Onboarding Checklist

global_flags.label: Live Arabic Audio AI Clinical Scribe

mobile_pwa.banner: Installable Browser App Card with 1-click PWA trigger, iOS Safari & Android Chrome installation guide, preview screen frame.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards, dropdowns, table rows).
Keep styling aligned with the existing Sand/Forest/Sage/Terracotta visual system.
Implement the persistent STAGING environment top bar cleanly without hiding main navigation.
Deliverect-style Super Admin UI must feature account search by name or ID, recent accounts list, account switcher ID chip, status badges, and 8-tab account detailed settings.
Landing Page must look investor-ready with trust badges, live interactive proof widgets, white-label preview simulator, compliance disclosures, and dual Arabic/English locale toggle.
